knownGaps: The 'until this artifact leaves the battlefield' return condition (Oblivion-Ring-style linked exile) has no tracked linkage anywhere in this engine model — nothing remembers which permanent THIS specific object exiled, and nothing fires a 'this leaves the battlefield' consequence to return it. Checked the rest of the pool for precedent before accepting this as a gap rather than modeling it: champions-of-the-perfect, y-shtola-rhul, and zenos-yae-galvus-shinryu-transcendent-rival all have the identical real mechanic and are equally unmodeled/documentary-only — this is a genuine, pool-wide engine gap, not a one-card oversight. The exile fact itself only claims the real, mechanically-executed half (exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls); its annotation is scoped to that clause only, not the unmodeled return clause.
